acceptanceCriteria: A toolchain or go-binary digest mismatch prints one typed REJECTED reason line and a distinct exit code
script/check-sql-native-ratchets_test.sh passes on the repository's admitted Go toolchain(s) at origin/main
The SNR spec names the admitted toolchain source instead of a hard-coded go1.27.0
body: Confirmed 2026-10-20 at origin/main 2b0cfce94 in a clean checkout: `bash script/check-sql-native-ratchets_test.sh` exits 1 with 'FAIL: at-ceiling source did not proceed to the receipt build:' and an empty captured output. Cause: script/check-sql-native-ratchets.sh:34-35 requires the GOROOT go binary sha256 and `GOVERSION = go1.27.0` under `set -e`; the repository pins go1.27.2 (host here has go1.27.3), so the script stops at the bare `test` with no reason printed, before the SNR-V0-005 ceiling path the test expects. The lane builder for V1-2115 saw the same failure identically at base 12a389110. Make targets at Makefile:394/400 run both scripts. Expected: a toolchain mismatch refuses with a typed reason line (e.g. status=REJECTED reason=TOOLCHAIN_MISMATCH) and the fixture test either pins its own admitted toolchain or asserts that refusal; the ratchet's toolchain pin follows the repository's admitted Go set (see V1-2118 go1.27.3 admission). Actual: silent exit, always-failing test.

title: check-sql-native-ratchets.sh pins go1.27.0 and exits silently under the repository's Go toolchain, so its fixture test always fails
